stories.title: Mbappé's favorite meme, his face on Mao, costs him Chinese sponsors
stories.summary: In a clip from the French show The Bridge, Kylian Mbappé laughed that his favorite meme put his face on "some guy, I think he's a Chinese dictator." It was Mao Zedong. Chinese brands Mengniu, Dongpeng and Milkground ended their deals with him, and state broadcaster CCTV suspended La Liga broadcasts. Mbappé apologized for the "ill-judged" comment (456K likes), and La Liga apologized too. It came a day after "cry harder Mbappé" jokes about him losing the Ballon d'Or to Harry Kane.

stories.title: "*paws at you*": the wide-eyed snow leopard meme
stories.summary: An AI-edited photo of Himmel, a snow leopard at Japan's Ishikawa Zoo, with Mei Mei the cat's huge eyes became the day's reaction image. People captioned it "*paws at you*" over and over to nag friends. Two posts with it got 151K and 145K likes within hours, and Epic Games joined in the next day with "*paws at you* hop online."
